subject.title: fix(env): propagate service-managed GH_TOKEN to trusted exec

question: Should a gateway installed from an owner-controlled state-directory environment automatically expose GH_TOKEN and GITHUB_TOKEN to all gateway/full/off exec children?
rationale: The implementation can enforce either policy correctly, but source and tests cannot decide whether convenient GitHub CLI authentication outweighs expanding the credentials automatically available to model-invoked host commands.

options.title: Approve the GH-only boundary
options.body: Accept the narrowly enumerated credentials for gateway/full/off execution, then require a current-main refresh and green checks before merge.

options.title: Require Linux service proof
options.body: Keep the proposed boundary but request one redacted Linux/systemd install-restart-exec transcript before approval.

options.title: Keep exec credentials strict
options.body: Decline automatic environment inheritance and document gh auth login or another GitHub CLI credential-store workflow instead.

recommendation.title: Approve the GH-only boundary
recommendation.body: Accept the narrowly enumerated credentials for gateway/full/off execution, then require a current-main refresh and green checks before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The current-main history most strongly connects this person to exec policy defaults, trusted host execution semantics, and adjacent security-sensitive behavior.
